nodes.label: LLM Wiki: Persistent Knowledge Base Pattern
nodes.rationale: Pattern for building personal knowledge bases using LLMs; LLM incrementally builds and maintains persistent wiki (markdown files) between raw sources and user; cross-references, contradictions, synthesis compiled once and kept current.

nodes.label: LLM Wiki Three-Layer Architecture
nodes.rationale: Raw sources (immutable), wiki layer (LLM-generated markdown, owned by LLM), schema layer (configuration document defining structure and workflows); human curates sources and asks questions; LLM does maintenance.

nodes.label: LLM Wiki Operations: Ingest, Query, Lint
nodes.rationale: Ingest: process new source, update 10-15 wiki pages. Query: search relevant pages, synthesize answer, file results back as new pages. Lint: health-check for contradictions, stale claims, orphan pages, missing cross-references.

nodes.label: LLM Wiki Indexing and Logging
nodes.rationale: index.md: content-oriented catalog (links, summaries, metadata); log.md: append-only chronological record (ingests, queries, lints) with parseable prefixes; enables navigation and timeline of wiki evolution.
